watches.name: Royal's Reserve Spectrum 40mm Blue Dial
watches.description: The Bowman London Royal's Reserve Spectrum is a refined, British-designed timepiece that celebrates colour, precision, and timeless craftsmanship. Inspired by the natural beauty of the colour spectrum, each watch pairs elegant proportions with everyday versatility. Crafted from durable 316L stainless steel, it's powered by the Seiko TMI VH60 sweep second movement, with a smooth sweeping seconds hand and 24-hour subdial at 6 o'clock, offering refined performance and dependable reliability. A scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, screw-down crown and case back, and 100-metre water resistance ensure durability to match its elegant styling. Specs. Case:40 millimeter316L stainless steel, 12 millimeter thickness Movement: Seiko TMI VH60 sweep second with smooth sweeping seconds and 24-hour subdial. Crystal: Sapphire. Water resistance: 100 meters. Strap options: steel bracelet, leather, or NATO. Design: British by Bowman London.

watches.name: ORBITAL GAMMA AUTOMATIC JET BLACK
watches.description: Inspired by NASA’s Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter. Since 2009, the LRO has circled the moon about every 110 minutes, mapping its surface with pinpoint accuracy and building the foundation for future exploration. The Orbital Gamma channels that exacting rhythm and engineering focus into its integrated steel form. Specifications: 40 mm 316L stainless steel case with integrated bracelet. Sapphire crystal. Exhibition sapphire case back. Citizen Miyota 21 joule automatic movement, 42 hour power reserve, gold tone signed rotor. 100 meters water resistance. Applied indices with Super LumiNova. Date at 3 o’clock. Brushed and polished integrated case finish.

watches.name: DESIGNATION Mk1 GREENWICH DIVER
watches.description: DESIGNATION MK1 GREENWICH The Designation MK1 Greenwich draws from the birthplace of modern timekeeping. At Greenwich, the Prime Meridian established a reference for global navigation, while John Harrison’s marine chronometer solved the challenge of determining longitude at sea, transforming maritime navigation. That legacy lives on in a modern British dive watch, carrying the coordinates of Greenwich on its dial and paying tribute to the precision, exploration and engineering that helped Britain navigate the world. Specifications 40 mm 316L stainless steel case 200 metre water resistance Scratch resistant sapphire crystal with anti reflective coating Unidirectional dive bezel Navy sunburst dial Applied Super LumiNova hour markers Broad arrow hour hand and sword minute hand Screw down crown Milanese stainless steel bracelet with folding clasp Movement Citizen Miyota 8215 automatic mechanical movement 21 jewels 21,600 vibrations per hour Approximately 42 hour power reserve Automatic and manual winding

watches.name: ORBITAL GAMMA CHRONOGRAPH ROYAL BLUE
watches.description: Orbital Gamma Chronograph. Inspired by NASA’s Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter, which has mapped the moon continuously since 2009, completing an orbit approximately every 110 minutes, the Orbital Gamma Chronograph channels that precision and cadence into a clear, instrument inspired design. The Orbiter bezel nods to that 110-minute rhythm as a signature design cue. evocative, not literal. Specifications. 40mm 316L stainless steel case, VK63 Mechanical Hybrid chronograph movement, sapphire crystal, 100 meters water resistance, royal blue sunburst dial, three recessed subdials with concentric finish, applied indices with Super-LumiNova, red central chronograph seconds hand, fixed Orbiter bezel, and an integrated brushed and polished stainless steel bracelet.

watches.name: Airbus 1700 Calibre MKI  34/45
watches.description: Airbus 1700 Calibre MKI. Limited Edition – Only 45 Units Worldwide A tribute to airspace, precision, and those who move with intent. Built with the same precision that defines the helicopters trusted by the UK Ministry of Defence, this watch embodies rugged reliability and military excellence. Airbus Helicopters UK, a leading name in aerospace manufacturing, plays a crucial role in training and preparing UK Forces pilots for their missions, using models like the H135 Juno and H145 Jupiter. Their helicopters also serve critical roles in the UK, providing nearly two-thirds of the nation’s air ambulances and supporting police operations. Airbus helicopters are indispensable in firefighting, search and rescue, and humanitarian missions, also supporting the oil and gas industries. Limited to only 45 pieces, the Airbus MKI is a true masterpiece. The captivating blue matt dial is adorned with luminous hands and markers, allowing for easy reading in any lighting condition. The 24-hour sub-dial at 3 o'clock, 60-minute sub-dial at 9 o'clock, and 60-second sub-dial at 6 o'clock add to the functionality and elegance of the watch. Designed for ultimate protection, the Airbus MKI features a Sapphire crystal that guards against scratches and wear. The screw-down crown, screw-down pushers, and screw-down case-back ensure a high level of water resistance, up to 200 meters. At the heart of this extraordinary timepiece lies a highly precise SII Corporation Mechanical/Hybrid VK63 movement, certified byl Bowman London. This cutting-edge movement combines mechanical and hybrid technologies to deliver exceptional accuracy and reliability, making the Airbus MKI a true masterpiece of horological engineering.

watches.name: The Britannic Frostguard Series Arctic Blue 69°N 19°E
watches.description: Introducing The Britannic Frostguard Series , a celebration of British courage and precision, forged in the heart of two icy frontiers. In the frozen north, conquering the brutal Arctic terrain of Norway; across the Alps, British Olympians chase glory on the slopes of Italy. Two distinct editions, the Arctic White and the Alpine Blue Each timepiece bears its own coordinates, marking theatres of endurance and triumph, and stands as a proud symbol of our mission to push the limits of design and performance. More than a timekeeper, each watch is a testament to the British spirit, a union of Arctic resilience and Alpine ambition. Under the banner of the United Kingdom, you wear not just precision and elegance, but a legacy crafted with pride for every mission ahead. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS Range Model: The Britannic Frostguard Series Case Diameter: 42mm Case Thickness: 12.5mm Material: Military-grade stainless steel (case + bracelet) Closure: Butterfly deployant clasp Lug-to-Lug: 50mm Bracelet Range: Adjustable from 6.5" to 8.5" Crystal: Anti-scratch, anti-stain Sapphire Movement: Citizen 21-Jewel automatic Crown / Case Back: Screw-down, fully sealed Weight: 177g Water Resistance: 200m / 20 BAR / 660ft SPECIAL FEATURES Rotating unidirectional bezel Luminous hands and indices (Super-LumiNova - Blue) Full sapphire crystal – anti-reflective, combat-grade Screw-down crown system for secure water ingress protection ISSUED WITH Bowman London presentation case Bowman London limited warranty: • 5-Year UK coverage • 3-Year International coverage
